_comment: docs/57 §6.2 / §12.5 / §14.1. Adding, changing or removing an entry requires the user's decision (Q6). Required: id, mode, fullName (complete test name), symptoms (stable message fragments, ALL must appear; whitespace-normalized), cause, approvedBy, approvedOn, approvalRef, source (baseline evidence), reinvestigateWhen. A known test failing with any other symptom is reported as NEW_FAILURE. Verify against records with: classify_results.py --verify-entries <records>.
